name: One Pyromancer Seal of Alar per caster on each recipient (#4883)
contract: Seal of Al'ar ranks 1-5 share the chain 803649 -> 803729 -> 807704 -> 807770 -> 808012 (spell_ranks, rev_20260903_01) and Greater Seal of Al'ar 808060 (same +33 mana regen as rank 5, raid version) is unranked; no spell_group listed them, so Aura::CanStackWith let the lesser and greater seals stay on one recipient (#4883). They share spell group 1144 with stack rule 2 (SPELL_GROUP_STACK_RULE_EXCLUSIVE_FROM_SAME_CASTER): the newest replaces the caster's previous one, while a second Pyromancer's still coexists - the same shape as the Starcaller Celestial Mind (1142) group. Only the first rank is listed because SpellMgr::LoadSpellGroups drops any other rank and chains resolve through GetFirstSpellInChain.

steps.label: Seal of Al'ar on the ally
Greater Seal of Al'ar from the same caster
Greater Seal of Al'ar is applied
It replaced the same caster's Seal of Al'ar
A second Pyromancer gives Seal of Al'ar
The other caster's Seal of Al'ar coexists (rule 2, not rule 1)
